name: agent-utilities
description: Reusable local utility skills for agent environments, tool ownership, memory curation, configuration, and persistent-state maintenance.

interface.shortDescription: Utilities for local agent environments and state.
interface.longDescription: A personal local plugin for reusable agent utility workflows. It coordinates developer environment maintenance, runtime and tool ownership, shared tool registries, structure-aware Codex memory audits, and safe ad-hoc memory change requests without directly modifying generated memory state.
defaultPrompt: Use maintain-dev-env when a task is blocked or may be misled by missing tools, PATH/shim issues, package-manager ownership, project runtime requirements, or toolchain install/update/repair needs.
Use setup-dev-env to inspect my local developer environment before installing anything.
Use manage-scoop for Windows Scoop checks and updates.
Use manage-mise for directly managed runtimes and tools, outer runtime layers, and Node/npm global-prefix diagnostics.

Use maintain-dev-tool-list to update the shared developer tool registry, including npm-global tools such as OpenCLI, without flattening nested manager ownership, and keep mise-managed Node postinstall recovery synchronized.
Use curate-codex-memory to audit generated Codex memory state, review noisy or unsafe entries, and preview authorized ad-hoc change notes without directly editing generated memory files.
